title: Capstone mentors joined for a research workshop
summary: Capstone mentors joined last September 28 for a research workshop. Facilitated by Dr. Roberto T. Borromeo, the workshop aims to strengthen the mentors' skills in guiding learners for their capstone projects.

title: Grade 12 learners showcase innovation at Capstone Fair
summary: Last April 28, SHS learners participated in the annual Capstone Fair.
